correctness.rationale: For product framing, \(H_1\) is \(\operatorname{coker}(A_S)\oplus\mathbb Z/d\) with \(d=\gcd(p,q)\). The quotient \(\operatorname{coker}(A_S)\to\operatorname{coker}(Q_{p,g})\oplus\operatorname{coker}(Q_{q,h})\) is visibly surjective, so its finite order is divisible by \(pq\). The source adapted bases identify those factor cokernels as \(\mathbb Z/p\) and \(\mathbb Z/q\). Exact replay reconstructs three integral symplectic matrices, checks \(S^\top J S=J\), enumerates all maximal minors, and obtains determinantal divisors \(16\), \(9\), and \(12\); hence the total orders are exactly \(64\), \(27\), and \(24\), and the quotient-surjection is an isomorphism at the minima.
